title: Sound and speech
intro: Set key sounds, kana pronunciation, segment speech and sentence speech independently. Japanese voices are provided by your browser and device.
keySoundEnabledHelp: Play a short electronic sound when typing letters during practice.
kanaSpeechEnabledHelp: Read each kana after you complete it, then move to the next question.
articleSegmentSpeechEnabledHelp: Read completed segments while you keep typing. When a sentence is finished, read the full sentence instead.
articleSpeechEnabledHelp: Read each completed sentence. Press Enter to skip.
mutedHelp: Key sound volume is 0, so practice and previews are muted. Move the slider right to hear key sounds.
missingVoiceHelp: The saved voice is unavailable on this device. Another Japanese voice will be tried automatically.
voiceHelp: Automatic selection prefers the local Kyoko voice, then other Japanese voices. Online voices may require an internet connection.
pitchHelp: A brighter pitch is used by default. Voice and pitch changes depend on your device.
previewHelp: Previews use the current volume, regardless of practice sound switches.
keyUnsupported: This browser does not support key sounds.
keyFailed: Key sounds could not play. Select “Retry key sound”.
speechUnsupported: This browser does not support speech. You can continue typing.
speechMissing: No Japanese voice was found. Install a Japanese voice on your device and retry. You can continue typing.
speechFallback: The selected Japanese voice is unavailable. Another Japanese voice is being used.
speechFailed: Japanese speech could not play. You can continue typing.
speechTimedOut: Japanese speech timed out and was stopped.
speechNotStarted: Japanese speech could not start. You can continue typing.
